name: com.orbvector/orb-vector-mcp
title: Orb Vector
description: Great Circle flight routes, solar window seats, overflight, range & airport hub MCP tools.

tools.name: get_flight_route_telemetry
tools.description: Compute full Great Circle & Rhumb Line aviation telemetry for an airport pair across 15 aircraft profiles (e.g. airbus-a350-900ulr, airbus-a350-1000, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, gulfstream-g650er, boeing-747-8): distance (km/nm/mi), headings, latitude-aware wind profile, 110m sovereign polygon overflight (with ISO-3 codes & corridor segments), solar window-seat recommendations, all-cabin CO2 emissions, aircraft range feasibility, reciprocal return flight delta, nearby corridors, and the canonical 3D globe URL.

origin.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the departure airport (e.g. SIN, JFK).

dest.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the arrival airport (e.g. JFK, LHR).

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 supported profiles (e.g. boeing-747-8, airbus-a350-900ulr, airbus-a350-1000, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, boeing-737-max-8, gulfstream-g650er, concorde). Defaults to Boeing 747-8.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

departure_preset.description: Optional departure time window for solar/terminator seat analysis. If omitted, returns all 4 deterministic presets.

tools.name: recommend_window_seat
tools.description: Analyze solar azimuth, day/night terminator crossings, aurora borealis/australis probability, and time zone shift along a flight path to recommend the best scenic and glare-free window seat (left vs right side).

departure_preset.description: Departure time preset for solar modeling. Defaults to morning.

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or name among 15 profiles for cruise speed duration scaling.

include_samples.description: Optional flag to include the 25-point trajectory solar sample array in structuredContent. Defaults to false for compact responses.

tools.name: get_airport_hub_profile
tools.description: Retrieve geographic coordinates, hemisphere classification, antipode location, elevation/runway operational briefing (for major hubs), and connected Great Circle routes for a global airport IATA code.

iata.description: 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g. LHR, SIN, DXB).

tools.name: find_nearby_corridors
tools.description: Discover alternative major commercial airports near the origin and destination to compare corridor distances and detour penalties.

limit.description: Maximum number of alternative corridors to return (1-8, default 4).

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search 7,906 global airports by city name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code to resolve valid 3-letter IATA airport codes before calling route tools.

query.description: City name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code (2-80 chars).

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, JP, GB) or country name filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching airports to return (1-20, default 8).

tools.name: list_aircraft_profiles
tools.description: List all 15 Orb Vector API aircraft performance profiles (widebodies including A350-900ULR/1000, B787-9, B777-300ER, A380-800, narrowbodies including A321XLR/B737-MAX8, Business Jet G650ER, Concorde, military & GA) with 3-segment Breguet payload-range envelopes.

tools.name: evaluate_aircraft_range
tools.description: Evaluate non-stop range feasibility (`feasibilityStatus`), Breguet allowable payload, flight duration, and all-cabin CO2 emissions across up to 15 aircraft profiles for an airport pair (origin + dest) or mission distance (distance_km). Ranks all 15 aircraft profiles when aircraft is omitted.

origin.description: Optional 3-letter IATA origin airport code (provide together with dest, or pass distance_km).

dest.description: Optional 3-letter IATA destination airport code (provide together with origin, or pass distance_km).

distance_km.description: Optional mission distance in kilometers (1-25,000) when origin/dest are omitted.

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 profiles (e.g. airbus-a350-900ulr, boeing-787-9, airbus-a321xlr, gulfstream-g650er). If omitted, evaluates and ranks all 15 profiles.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

tools.name: calculate_multi_leg_route
tools.description: Compute a multi-stop Great Circle itinerary across 2 to 8 airport waypoints across 15 aircraft profiles, returning leg-by-leg distances, headings, range feasibility, cumulative & per-cabin CO2, circuityRatio vs nonstop, 110m sovereign polygon overflight, and solar window-seat guidance.

waypoints.description: Ordered array of 2-8 3-letter IATA airport codes (e.g. ["JFK", "LHR", "DXB", "SIN"]).

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 profiles. Defaults to Boeing 747-8.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

departure_preset.description: Optional departure window for multi-leg solar window-seat analysis. Defaults to morning.
